blackout.description: Six rescue agents keep working toward one goal when their network fails. Scouts and rescuers share knowledge over a simulated radio mesh, keep acting on their own when cut off, and merge what they learned when links return. Gemini, ElevenLabs and n8n. Built for the Neptune North challenge at GreatUniHack 2026.

least-privilege.description: Team repo for Great Uni Hack 2026 - Least Privilege

markus-he.description: an AI money coach that reads your past transactions to warn you about money problems weeks before they happen, shows what being short has cost you, and how big a surprise you could survive. Built for people on low or irregular incomes with little financial knowledge.

phpirates.description: PHPatch — self-coordinating PHP patch fleet (Neptune North @ GreatUniHack 2026): agents patch each server and spread the fix peer-to-peer, even when central control is lost.

texasholdem.description: Exploitative No-Limit Texas Hold'em AI poker bot built in Python for the MUDS Challenge at GreatUniHack 2026.
